adoption.value: Accept with explicit edits: primary A/B-geo/B-mat/C/D, separate E CPU visibility and F historical baseline as secondary controls, state geometry-only two coordinated edits and object readback, retain fixed numerical thresholds and no Blender until resources allow; publish the closed pre-Blender contract without calling it physical validation.

tolerance_and_gate.value: Freeze 1e-9 as a preregistered acceptance threshold (and 1e-12 CPU), require actual save/reopen object readback and report any failure without changing thresholds; keep experiment blocked until resource gate and final review.
